preferDiscovered.title: Reuse codex-cli when our vault is empty

cloudSync.connectionHint: Configure the WebDAV server connection in Settings → Data → WebDAV Sync first — the subscription sync shares it.
cloudSync.description: Mirror an encrypted copy of your subscription vaults (accounts, presets, active pointers) to your WebDAV server. Zero-knowledge: the server only ever sees ciphertext.
cloudSync.passphraseHint: Independent from the data-backup passphrase. With “remember passphrase” enabled in Data settings it is kept in the OS keyring for unattended syncs.
cloudSync.passphraseUnlockedPlaceholder: Unlocked — leave blank to reuse the cached passphrase
cloudSync.restoreDialogBody: Download the latest subscription snapshot from WebDAV and unlock it for preview. Nothing is written until you confirm.
cloudSync.restorePreviewBody: Review what will be written into this device’s keyring. Existing accounts with the same id are replaced.
cloudSync.title: Cloud sync (WebDAV)

importExport.description: Export your subscription vaults as an encrypted file so you can restore them on another machine.
importExport.exportDialogBody: Pick a passphrase. The file is encrypted with AES-GCM using PBKDF2-SHA256 (600 000 iterations) so the passphrase is the only thing standing between this backup and your tokens.
importExport.fileFieldHint: Drop a `.cogniabak` file here or click to choose.
importExport.importDialogBody: Pick an encrypted backup file and enter the passphrase used when it was created.
importExport.passphraseWrong: The passphrase didn't decrypt this file.

preview.description: Review what this file will write back before applying. Existing accounts with the same id are upserted; presets and active-account pointers are restored from the file.
preview.empty: This backup is empty — no accounts or presets to import.
preview.title: Preview the backup

importExport.title: Backup

preset.modelMappingHint: Remaps the model env vars passed to the provider. Leave blank to keep the upstream default.

preset.validationEmptyKey: Header keys must not be blank.

customSources.title: Custom sources
